title: What the evidence base is made of
question: Before any result: what rows exist, how completely are they covered, and how large is each split?

title: Which instruments the analysis covers
question: Is the instrument universe point-in-time, and how did its membership change?

title: Distributions and feature behaviour
question: What do the numeric distributions look like, and which features cannot vary on the rows selected?

title: Microstructure and liquidity proxies
question: What do the liquidity and microstructure proxies show, and which quantities does this data source simply not express?

title: Regime statistics
question: How are regimes distributed over the sample, and how thin is the smallest of them?

title: Dependence and propagation
question: How does movement propagate across instruments, and how strong is the typical association?

title: Tails and extreme risk
question: How heavy are the tails on your slice, and how deep did the drawdowns get?

title: Episode and event statistics
question: How are the injected episodes distributed across instruments and sessions?

title: Leakage verification
question: Can information from after a decision time reach a feature?

title: Validation metrics at a threshold you choose
question: What do the validation metrics say at a threshold you choose?

title: Calibration and uncertainty
question: Are the scores calibrated at the bin count you choose?

title: Error analysis
question: Where does the scoring fail, and what kind of failure is each mistake?

title: Baseline comparison
question: How do the baselines compare, and is the full stack better than something simpler?

title: Ablation study
question: Which components carry the result, and how much does removing each one cost?

title: Robustness and generalisation
question: What survives perturbation, and how much quality is lost when the inputs degrade?

title: Seeds and significance
question: How much of the difference between arms is seed noise?
